title: The same wrong version looks correct on flat data
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun sumAll(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> sum(o pluck ((value) -> if (value is Number) value else 0))
  case a is Array -> sum(a map ((item) -> if (item is Number) item else 0))
  else -> 0
}
---
sumAll({"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3})

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
fun sumAll(v) = v match {
  case o is Object -> sum(o pluck ((value) -> if (value is Number) value else 0))
  case a is Array -> sum(a map ((item) -> if (item is Number) item else 0))
  else -> 0
}
---
sumAll({"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3})

explanation.approach: This is exactly why the bug survives a quick check — a flat object has nothing nested inside it to expose the missing recursive call.
